column1: # tests/absence-rule-census.tsv — every absence rule in tests/test-lib.sh, and
# every function the absence detector flags that is not one. Read by hand.
#   PROVED   shown able to fail by rows in ABSENCE_RULES: it passes an untouched
#            copy of the tree, and fails a stripped one and a planted one
#   PENDING  an absence rule nothing has yet shown able to fail — the debt
#   NOT      flagged by tests/absence-candidates.awk; a reader found it is not
#            an absence rule, and says what it is instead
# Made on 2026-09-14 from three readings of function bodies: a full audit of the
# suite's absence rules (113 named, 5 later judged not to be), then a
# reading of every other function the detector flagged, twice as it was widened.
# Moving a row to PROVED means adding its rows to ABSENCE_RULES and lowering
# ABSENCE_PENDING in tests/test-lib.sh, in the same change.
